{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the underwater vehicle|the [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]], also known as a repulsorsled}}
'''Sleds''' were [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] vehicles that were used in [[Coral City/Legends|Mon Calamari City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
During a field trip to the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Roan Novachez]] used a sled to ride on when [[Gender/Legends|he]] and his classmates went [[sledding]] down a hill.<ref name="Return">''[[Jedi Academy: Return of the Padawan]]''</ref>
{{Noncanonend}}
